openAiMarkdown:
# Changelog

## August, 2026

### Aug 7

Feature · Model: daybreak-blue-latest

Daybreak is now available to approved defenders. Read the [Daybreak model guide](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/daybreak-blue-latest).

### Aug 6

Update · Model: chat-latest

Updated [chat-latest](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/chat-latest), now available for Plus users.
anthropicMarkdown:
### July 24, 2026

* We've launched **Claude Opus 5** (`claude-opus-5`), available on the [Claude API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/whats-new-opus-5).
* The `fallbacks` parameter now supports a [default mode](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/refusals-and-fallback).

### June 30, 2026

* We've launched **Claude Sonnet 5**, available on the [Claude API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/whats-new-sonnet-5).
